# Çukurova Tius Otel

> Pet-friendly Çukurova Tius Otel in Osmaniye: 85 rooms among greenery, an 85-item breakfast buffet, a garden with gazebos, free parking and Wi-Fi.

A hotel in Osmaniye, Türkiye. The website is in Turkish (default) and English. There is no online payment or live availability: guests pick their dates and send a reservation request on WhatsApp, and the hotel replies.

## Contact

- Address: Murat Kurum Bey Mah. 25105 Sok. No: 32/78, 80000 Merkez / Osmaniye, Türkiye
- Phone: +903288122211
- WhatsApp (reservations): +905428122211 — https://wa.me/905428122211
- E-mail: cukurovasuitotel@gmail.com
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=%C3%87ukurova%20Tius%20Otel%2C%2025105%20Sok.%20No%3A32%2C%20Osmaniye

## Key facts

- Check-in: 14:00
- Check-out: 12:00
- Parking: Free
- Air conditioning: Available
- Furry guests: Pet Friendly
- Breakfast: open buffet with about 85 items; weekdays 07:00–10:30, weekends 07:00–11:00
- Garden with gazebos, free Wi-Fi

## Room types

- Single Oda / Single Room: 1 tek kişilik yatak; With one single bed, for guests travelling alone.
- Double Oda / Double Room: 1 çift kişilik yatak; With one double bed, for two guests.
- Double + Single Oda / Double + Single Room: 1 çift + 1 tek kişilik yatak; One double and one single bed, for up to three guests.
- Double + Twin Oda / Double + Twin Room: 1 çift + 2 tek kişilik yatak; One double and two single beds, for up to four guests; suited to families.
- Twin Oda / Twin Room: 2 tek kişilik yatak; Two separate single beds, for friends or colleagues.
- Triple Twin Oda / Triple Twin Room: 3 tek kişilik yatak; Three single beds, for groups of three.
